rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 14 independently acquired datasets from 25 scan sites
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "A final sample of 1294 cases and 1465 controls was obtained from a larger cohort drawn from 14 separate, independently acquired datasets and 25 scan sites following various exclusion criteria"

rci2_using_epd.detail: ABIDE I and ABIDE II (12 sites) provided ASD cases and matched HCs; TOP15 provided BP and SCZ cases and matched HCs. HC row in Table 1 states 'All clinical datasets, MON', confirming HCs from these EPDs are included in the reference cohort.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "ABIDE I (70) (CALTECH, CMU, LEUVEN_1, MAX_MUN, NYU, PITT, UK, SBL, USM), ABIDE II (71) (BNI, IU)" ... "TOP15 (79)" ... HC: "All clinical datasets, MON (74)"

rci3_epd_name.detail: ABIDE I (9 sites) and ABIDE II (2 sites) used for ASD group; TOP15 used for BP and SCZ groups. HCs drawn from all clinical datasets including these EPDs. Other datasets (ASRB, FEMS, MON, IMpACT-NL, KANMDD, MITASD, OCDPG, RUSMDD, SPAINOCD, WASHASD, YoDA) are in-house or not in the confirmed EPD list.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "ABIDE I (70) (CALTECH, CMU, LEUVEN_1, MAX_MUN, NYU, PITT, UK, SBL, USM), ABIDE II (71) (BNI, IU)" ... "TOP15 (79)"

model-1.model-name: voxelwise white matter volume normative model

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC (HCtrain); created by randomly selecting 90% of controls from each site (or all controls if site had <30 HCs). Total HC = 1465; HCtrain = 1196, HCtest = 269. Note: Supplementary Methods states 'HCtrain, n = 1,465' which appears to be a typo; the main text clearly states n = 1196 and 1196 + 269 = 1465.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Following stratification of the sample into training (HCtrain, n = 1196) and test (clinical data, n = 1294; HCtest, n = 269) subsets"
rci5_n.location: Segal2025.pdf.md: Methods / Voxel-Scale WMV Heterogeneity, L77

model-1.model-name: voxelwise white matter volume normative model

rci6_sex.detail: Sex breakdown not separately reported for the training subset (HCtrain, n=1196). Overall HC (N=1465) reported as 54.47% male (approx. 798 males, 667 females, 45.5% female). Training is a 90% random subsample by site, so proportions are expected to be similar.
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "1465 (54.47%)" [column header: n (% Male), overall HC row in Table 1]; no separate training-phase sex breakdown provided

model-1.model-name: voxelwise white matter volume normative model

rci7_age.detail: Mean and SD not separately reported for the training subset (HCtrain, n=1196). Paper reports median (not mean) and SD for overall HC (N=1465): median=27, SD=10.70, range 18-64. Age range 18-64 derives from study inclusion criteria ('All individuals were 18 to 64 years old') and applies to all participants including training subset. Age in years.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "All individuals were 18 to 64 years old" ... "27 (10.70) [18 - 64]" [column header: Age, Years, Median (SD) [Range], overall HC row in Table 1]
